The climate in Eindhoven

Eindhoven is about 15 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 24°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 2°C. Around 840 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in January (about 76 mm).

Best time to visit Eindhoven

The most pleasant weather in Eindhoven is usually in June, July, August and September: average highs are between 20°C and 24°C, with up to 13 days of rain a month.
